stem.text: Which statement correctly describes the movement of solutes in the symplast pathway?

A.text: Cell surface membranes regulate the selective absorption of solutes into the symplast pathway.

B.text: Plasmodesmata control the movement of solutes from the symplast pathway to the apoplast pathway.

C.text: The symplast pathway transports dissolved mineral ions from the soil that **cannot** be transported by the apoplast pathway.

D.text: The movement of solutes through plasmodesmata in the symplast pathway is prevented in the endodermis by suberin.
